curation_note: Hand-picked closed issues about upgrading from V1 to V2. Version scopes, resolution status and root-cause notes were labelled manually from the issue text; author roles are GitHub author_association values, not guesses.

resolution.summary: BaseSettings moved to the separate pydantic-settings package; install it, or use `from pydantic.v1 import BaseSettings` to keep V1 behaviour.
Same error text as #6777 but a different root cause: a third-party package (chroma) still required Pydantic <2.0, so the fix was a dependency conflict, not migrating BaseSettings.

documents.version_basis: Reported against 2.0.2; later versions not verified, so the scope stops at the reported version.

resolution.summary: The documentation link inside the BaseSettings import error was wrong in 2.0.2; maintainers added a redirect (#6527).

documents.version_basis: Feature request filed for the V2 release.

resolution.summary: allow_mutation was removed in V2; use the `frozen` config with the inverse meaning (allow_mutation=False is frozen=True). Wording was clarified in PR #6184.

documents.version_basis: Report compares V1 behaviour with V2.

resolution.summary: V2 no longer validates a model instance as a dict (what V1 parse_obj_as(dict, m) relied on). Closed as not planned; suggested workaround is a before validator.
